scope: Unwired recorded-frozen byte reader only. No Docker, controller, native or HTTP integration.

review.verdict: No actionable findings for the unwired reader

verified: Literal A remains A after worktree and ref advance to B
Returned arrays and buffers do not expose mutable stored references
Only recorded case-owned frozen identities are accepted
Commit, tree, blob identity, hash, size and metadata guards remain enforced
Successful, rejected and cancelled reads preserve store inventory
Queued cancellation cannot start reader work
Active Git read closes before cancellation settles
Cancellation signals apply only to read operations
limitations: An active bounded filesystem operation may finish before cancellation is checked
One trusted store owner and the existing same-UID adversarial-writer exclusion remain
This does not accept a validation worker, project Node/build execution, full M2 or live operation
